_comment: P3-4 Docker Model Runner bodies EN（2026-11-03）。sections 与源侧固定小节对齐；sources 按索引对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: Pulls models from Docker Hub, any OCI-compatible registry or Hugging Face and runs them; supports LLMs and other AI models, with the exact list following official docs.
axes.runtime: Integrated into Docker Desktop and Docker Engine: starts models locally and serves them through OpenAI- and Ollama-compatible APIs (official docs).
axes.local_files: Models are stored and distributed as OCI artefacts; prompts and data are processed locally with no API key needed.
axes.background: A long-running local service callable by apps in the Docker ecosystem; no official statement of continuing after shutdown.
axes.tools: OpenAI/Ollama-compatible endpoints; Docker Agent can discover already-pulled models. Tool-calling and MCP not verified item by item.
axes.context: Long context depends on model and memory configuration; official presets cover low-memory and long-document setups.
axes.permissions: Runs inside the local Docker environment; permissions come from Docker and the host system.
axes.fit: Fits teams already on Docker who want model distribution inside container pipelines and a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Does not fit people avoiding Docker, extreme GPU optimisation, or a ready-made chat UI.

runs: This site has not completed throughput or VRAM tests; the conclusions cover runtime capability and licensing only.
unknowns:
